name: blas
description: Blas — a personal Irish learning system. Monorepo: frontend (Vite) + backend (Express) + pronunciation-asr (FastAPI).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c yellow,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend --if-present && npm run test -w backend --if-present
